title: std::unordered_multimap<Key,T,Hash,KeyEqual,Allocator>::end(size_type), std::unordered_multimap<Key,T,Hash,KeyEqual,Allocator>::cend(size_type)
summary: Returns an iterator to the element following the last element of the bucket with index n. This element acts as a placeholder, attempting to access it results in undefined behavior.
html:
local_iterator end( size_type n );
 (since C++11)
const_local_iterator end( size_type n ) const;
 (since C++11)
const_local_iterator cend( size_type n ) const;
 (since C++11)

Returns an iterator to the element following the last element of the bucket with index n. This element acts as a placeholder, attempting to access it results in undefined behavior.

Parameters

n - the index of the bucket to access

Return value

Iterator to the element following the last element.

Complexity

Constant.

See also
